culprit_citations.quoted_text: Members' capital at the end of the period | $ | 9.99

rationale: F16 expects distribution_rate <= income_yield_pct * 1.5. The raw filing reports 2025 net investment income ratio of 10.83%, so the heuristic threshold is 16.245%. The 2025 distributions table totals $1.012 per unit; using the financial highlights ending members' capital per unit of $9.99 gives a distribution rate of about 10.13%, which does not exceed the threshold. The source therefore supports the fund financials metric rather than the validation failure.
